title: Hyperliquid treasury firm seeking U.S. regulatory nod as a domestic futures platform
summary: The company said it's trying to establish a U.S. "futures commission merchant" with full compliance for activity with U.S. clients, though the timing is uncertain.

title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
summary: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.

title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
summary: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

title: Bitcoin tumbles to $76,000 as collapsing AI trade drags stocks sharply lower
summary: The post-election rally quickly reversed as AI stocks plunged, but cryptocurrencies held up relatively better despite a $1 billion liquidation wave.

title: What is TraderTraitor, the hacking squad behind the $6.3 billion Binance heist?
summary: The hacking group has been behind some of the crypto industry's most recent high-profile thefts.
